# dagsterplus_roles (Data Source)

Lists all Dagster+ custom roles in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_roles" "all" {}

output "roles" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_roles.all.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `roles` (Attributes List) All custom roles in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the role.
- `icon` (String) The icon name for the role.
- `id` (String) The role ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `name` (String) The role name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The permissions granted by this role.
- `role_type` (String) The scope of the role: deployment or organization.
